newsitem.title: UK: Protestant youth found dead in Belfast.
newsitem.headline: Protestant youth found dead in Belfast.

text.p: The body of a Protestant youth was found on Monday near the site of a small explosion in south Belfast, police said.
Police said they could not confirm that the youth might have been killed by a bomb he was handling.
They ruled out a sectarian attack as cause of the death and said they did not believe anyone else was involved in the death.
Northern Ireland has been gripped by a wave of Catholic violence since police allowed a Protestant parade down a Catholic zone of Portadown on Sunday.
Home-made bombs have been hurled at police in a wave of protest that has so far injured 80 people but killed no one.
Protestant Loyalists, who are waging a guerrilla war to keep Northern Ireland British, have not been involved in any of the weekend violence, security sources said.
They are officially observing a ceasefire they called in October 1994 but police say the truce has broken down and blame Loyalists for many recent attacks on Irish nationalist targets.
